title: AI Customer Service Platform
summary: An operations platform for AI customer-service agents, combining agent management, knowledge assets, analytics, and workflow governance in one workspace.
summaryZh: 一个面向 AI 客服智能体的运营平台，将智能体管理、知识资产、分析能力与流程治理整合到同一个工作台中。
intro: A dashboard-style platform for operating AI customer-service agents, with modules for agent management, knowledge assets, visitor interactions, analytics, and governance.
introZh: 一个面向 AI 客服智能体运营的工作台式平台，包含智能体管理、知识资产、访客互动、数据分析与平台治理等模块。

contentSections.title: Overview
contentSections.content: This project focuses on the operational side of AI customer service. Instead of presenting a single chatbot, the product organizes the full workspace around agent performance, knowledge management, visitor interactions, and platform governance.
contentSections.contentZh: 这个项目关注的是 AI 客服的运营侧，而不是单一聊天机器人本身。整个产品围绕智能体绩效、知识管理、访客互动和平台治理来组织工作空间。

contentSections.title: What It Shows
contentSections.content: The interface highlights a dense but structured information model: agent matrix, satisfaction, resolution rate, escalation rate, unknown-question rate, risk sessions, and operational actions. The goal is to help teams understand both service quality and operational efficiency at a glance.
contentSections.contentZh: 界面重点展示一个高密度但有结构的信息模型，包括智能体矩阵、满意度、解决率、转人工率、未知问题率、高风险会话以及运营动作入口。目标是帮助团队快速理解服务质量与运营效率。
